feature_name: BigQuery subscriptions table schema type conversions
summary: BigQuery subscriptions with Use table schema enabled now support type conversions for DATE, TIME, DATETIME, TIMESTAMP, NUMERIC, and BIGNUMERIC values.
extended_definition: BigQuery subscriptions with Use table schema enabled now support type conversions for DATE, TIME, DATETIME, TIMESTAMP, NUMERIC, and BIGNUMERIC values.

supporting_pages.title: Create BigQuery subscriptions \_|\_ Pub/Sub \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: When you use this option, remember to check the following additional requirements: The fields in the topic schema and the BigQuery schema must have the same names and their types must be compatible with each other.
Any messages that validated against a deleted schema revision at the time of publish cannot be written to BigQuery using a BigQuery subscription with Use topic schema enabled.
Use the default Pub/Sub service agent that lets any user with the ability to create subscriptions in the project to create a subscription that writes to the table.
